Cosmic Spectra

Ever imagined that a single beam of light could tell the story of the cosmos? ✨


At Cosmic Spectra, witness how the mysterious phenomenon of redshift unlocks the secrets of the expanding universe. 🚀

We begin our cosmic voyage with the Doppler Effect! The fascinating principle that explains how motion alters waves and then journey into how it gives rise to redshift, shaping our understanding of distant galaxies and the ever-growing universe. 🌌

Discover how tiny changes in light unveil enormous truths : from how galaxies move to how the universe itself continues to stretch and evolve. 🌈

✨ Highlights:
🔭 Understand how redshift proves the universe is expanding
📊 See how spectral shifts influence astronomical discoveries
💫 Explore how light transforms into cosmic spectra, revealing the universe’s hidden patterns

📅 Date: Friday, November 7, 2025
🕓 Time: 4:00 PM – 6:00 PM
📍 Venue: C-002
